# testing Provider

This document will show case as many of our features as possible in as little operations/models as possible.
This will then generate a SDK that we can more easily review than the test SDKs based on uber.yaml spec.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    testing = {
      source  = "hashicorp/testing"
      version = "0.0.1"
    }
  }
}

provider "testing" {
  host_name      = "..." # Optional - can use TESTING_HOST_NAME environment variable
  port           = "..." # Optional - can use TESTING_PORT environment variable
  server_url     = "..." # Optional - can use TESTING_SERVER_URL environment variable
  server_version = "..." # Optional - can use TESTING_SERVER_VERSION environment variable
  subdomain      = "..." # Optional - can use TESTING_SUBDOMAIN environment variable
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `app_id` (String, Sensitive) Configurable via environment variable `TESTING_APP_ID`.
- `bearer_auth` (String, Sensitive) HTTP Bearer. Configurable via environment variable `TESTING_BEARER_AUTH`.
- `client_id` (String, Sensitive) Client Credentials flow. client identifier. Configurable via environment variable `TESTING_CLIENT_ID`.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) Client Credentials flow. client secret. Configurable via environment variable `TESTING_CLIENT_SECRET`.
- `deprecated_query_param1` (String, Deprecated) A deprecated description
- `deprecated_query_param2` (String, Deprecated)
- `host_name` (String) The hostname of the server. (defaults to localhost)
- `http_headers` (Map of String) HTTP headers to include in all requests
- `lone_query_param` (String)
- `mobile_auth` (String, Sensitive) OAuth2 Password flow, a flow that is too
long to describe in a single line.. Configurable via environment variable `TESTING_MOBILE_AUTH`.
- `my_api_key` (String, Sensitive) API Key. Configurable via environment variable `TESTING_MY_API_KEY`.
- `oauth2` (String, Sensitive) OAuth2 Authorization. Configurable via environment variable `TESTING_OAUTH2`.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) HTTP Basic password. Configurable via environment variable `TESTING_PASSWORD`.
- `port` (String) The port on which the server is running. (defaults to 8080); must be one of ["80", "8080", "443"]
- `query_param1` (String) A long winded, multi-line description
for the query parameter number one.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) Configurable via environment variable `TESTING_SECRET`.
- `server_url` (String) Server URL (defaults to http://localhost:35123)
- `server_version` (String) (defaults to 1)
- `subdomain` (String) (defaults to api)
- `tls_skip_verify` (Boolean) Disable TLS verification in HTTP client
- `token_url` (String, Sensitive) Client Credentials flow. token URL. Configurable via environment variable `TESTING_TOKEN_URL`.
- `username` (String, Sensitive) HTTP Basic username. Configurable via environment variable `TESTING_USERNAME`.
